scenarios.scenario: Webhook forgery by an attacker without the secret
scenarios.rationale: HMAC-SHA256 over raw body with the per-connection secret, hmac.compare_digest; missing/bad signature 400 (tested).

scenarios.scenario: Webhook forgery by a holder of the generic_webhook secret (Zapier/Make account)
scenarios.rationale: UD5 accepted trade-off: the secret holder can inject closed-won emails into the seed. Impact limited to the owner's own ad audience; all exclusions still apply.
Upsert unique on (site_id, external_deal_id, email_bidx): replay yields 1 row (tested).
Declared Content-Length and actual bytes both capped at 256KB -> 413 (tested); 60/min rate limit.

scenarios.scenario: Cross-tenant identity match via shared blind index
scenarios.rationale: Every IdentifiedVisitor.email_bidx read filters site_id (tested with same bidx on another site).

scenarios.scenario: Suppressed / erased / do_not_resolve / agent / abuse person enters a seed
scenarios.rationale: Erased never ingested; build_seed re-checks suppression scopes and identity flags on every push (8-case matrix tested).

scenarios.scenario: Competitor seeded via company exclusion gap
scenarios.rationale: Domain-keyed company exclusion is import-guarded; inactive until the sibling company-exclusion module merges. Merge note: verify load_exclusions/match_excluded signatures and that the gate is live.
One lookalike row per connection; same spec reuses stored id with zero provider calls; Google DUPLICATE_LOOKALIKE -> exists.
Country ^[A-Z]{2}$ and ratio/expansion fixed allow-lists validated before the string is built; 422 otherwise (tested).

scenarios.scenario: Plaintext email in logs or at rest
scenarios.rationale: Only bidx + Fernet ciphertext stored; structlog calls log counts/site_id/provider only; caplog assertion in G1.
UD3: EEA and unknown-country rows excluded from Google seed; EEA lookalike country rejected (tested).
